pretreatment: solvent-cleaned, hot etching in an HCl/H3PO4 (3:1) solution for 5 min, rinsed with de-ionized water, and blow-dried with N2 gas
evidence: ZnO films were deposited on (0 0 0 1) sapphire substrates in an inductively heated quartz reactor operated at atmospheric pressure by ALD using DEZn and N2O, which were carried by purified nitrogen (N2) gas. (0 0 0 1) sapphire substrates were solvent-cleaned first, followed by hot etching in an HCl/H3PO4 (3:1) solution for 5 min, rinsed with de-ionized water, and blow-dried with N2 gas before loading.
